# BizLite Theme Replication Prompt

Copy the following prompt into a new coding-assistant conversation.

```text
Build a Laravel Blade-first business-app interface that faithfully reproduces the existing BizLite visual system below. Use Bootstrap 5.3, Blade, Vite, jQuery 3.7, Alpine 3, Lucide icons, Select2 with select2-bootstrap-5-theme, Flatpickr, SweetAlert2 and Laravel/Yajra DataTables. Do not substitute Tailwind-only components, a generic admin template, charts, a footer, FABs, skeletons, or features not specified.

Visual tokens (use CSS variables): light `--pri:#1b4fe0; --pri-soft:#EEF2FF; --pri-dark:#1338b0; --red:#D92B2B; --grn:#1B8A4E; --bg-page:#F4F6FB; --bg-side/#--bg-top/#--bg-card:#fff; --bg-inp:#F4F6FB; --bg-sub:#F8FAFF; --bg-hov:#EEF2FF; --tx1:#111827; --tx2:#6B7280; --tx3:#9CA3AF; --bdr:#E5E7EB; --bdr2:#D1D5DB; --rad:12px; --rad-s:4px; --fs-base:14px; --font:'Inter',sans-serif; --font-kh:'Noto Sans Khmer',sans-serif; --tr:.22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`. Card shadow is `0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06),0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04)`; dropdown shadow `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)`.

Dark theme: page `#0F1117`, side/top `#161B27`, card `#1E2435`, input `#252D3F`, sub `#1A2030`, hover `#1F2A44`, primary text `#F1F5F9`, secondary `#94A3B8`, muted `#64748B`, border `#2A3347`. The dark primary soft color is `#1e2f60`. Table light head/stripe/hover are `#F8FAFF/#FAFBFF/#EEF2FF`; dark equivalents `#1A2030/#192030/#1F2A44`.

Use a fixed 55px topbar and 250px fixed desktop sidebar (`56px` collapsed). The page canvas is light blue-gray; surfaces are white, thin neutral-bordered and softly elevated. The topbar has: 200px logo, desktop rail-collapse and mobile hamburger buttons, org selector, max-450px search (40px high, Ctrl+K hint), notification, English/Khmer selector, fullscreen, appearance dropdown, theme customization trigger, and profile menu. Topbar icon buttons are 44x44; generic icon buttons are 36x36; Lucide is the only icon family. Use a data-driven nested menu tree with group labels, active blue-tinted state, child accordion, and a popover submenu in collapsed desktop mode. Do not hardcode permissions in a view; supply already-authorized menu items from the backend.

At <=991px turn the sidebar into an off-canvas left drawer with a backdrop and hamburger; main becomes full width. Preserve a horizontal navigation mode on desktop, but show the mobile drawer under that breakpoint. Support `prefers-reduced-motion`; also adapt grids/toolbars at 767, 575, and 479px. Tables remain horizontally scrollable on mobile.

Build CSS variables for light/dark, Bootstrap color overrides, table tokens, six soft KPI icon palettes (blue/green/yellow/rose/purple/orange), semantic badge pairs, card/dropdown shadows, and runtime primary/radius/font overrides. Persist visual settings in localStorage and restore them in an inline head script before CSS paint. Offer mode, vertical/horizontal layout, collapsed sidebar, named primary colors (blue #2563EB, sky #0EA5E9, purple #7C3AED, emerald #059669, royal #1D4ED8, orange #EA580C, cyan #06B6D4, mint #10B981, coral #F43F5E), custom hex, Inter/Roboto/Poppins/Public Sans and rounding. Primary Bootstrap buttons must use `--pri`; outline-primary must invert on hover.

Create reusable Blade components: app layout, management page header (title, Lucide icon, Home breadcrumb, optional section/actions/description), list toolbar, statistics accordion, status badge, input label/input/error, primary/secondary/danger button, dropdown/modal, flash message, and switch field. The switch is a 44x24 native-checkbox-backed control with a 18px white thumb, blue active track, focus ring, hidden false input, disabled/error support and `role=switch`.

Make dashboard KPI cards: responsive grid, white/dark cards, label, large value, optional delta/subtext and 36px soft colored icon cell; card hover is subtle. Do not invent chart components. Build listing pages with page header, optional statistics accordion, filter/search toolbar, active filter chips, table card and responsive DataTable. Search debounce is 350ms; filter changes redraw; chips remove a filter; chosen hidden columns persist in localStorage; re-run Lucide after DataTables draw. Use themed head/stripe/hover rows, badges and icon actions. Provide export integration only if the chosen DataTables extension is installed; do not reference pdfMake without adding it.

For forms use card/section surfaces, `row g-3`, accessible labels, 14px Bootstrap inputs/selects with 4px control radius, muted help text, `is-invalid`/`invalid-feedback`, and Cancel + primary Save. `.input-icon-left` needs 42px left control padding and a primary focus icon. Initialize Select2 for searchable selects. Initialize Flatpickr date fields as `Y-m-d`, manual input allowed, with Clear/Today footer and a clear icon. Use Bootstrap modals/offcanvas/tooltips/accordions, SweetAlert2 for destructive confirmation, session Bootstrap alerts, an aria-live toast stack, and a loading GIF/DataTables processing state. Do not claim a universal toast or skeleton framework.

Implement an optional specialized POS sample: category chips, 2-pane catalog/cart, product tiles with image-or-package fallback, price/unit/stock badge, 250ms search debounce, async Load More, clear-cart confirmation, mobile cart drawer, and keyboard-wedge scanner recognition (6+ rapid characters, <=30ms gaps, Enter/Tab) without intercepting normal form editing. It requires real catalog/cart/post endpoints; do not fake persistence.

Internationalization: configure Laravel `en` and `km`; load Noto Sans Khmer yourself and use it for Khmer content. Ensure Khmer labels wrap/reflow without clipping; choose Khmer product/unit names where translated values exist. The language control must genuinely persist/set Laravel locale if implemented—do not use static demo labels. Localize dates/numbers through Laravel/Intl conventions, but keep source format `Y-m-d` for plain date fields unless the product asks otherwise.

Acceptance criteria: desktop has fixed 55px header and 250/56px rail; mobile drawer works at <=991px; light/dark changes all tokenized surfaces/tables/forms/modals; theme preferences restore without FOUC; nested nav and all panels close on Escape/outside click; all icon controls have accessible names; selected controls and DataTables redraw retain Lucide icons; listing/form/dashboard/POS samples match the colors, geometry and interaction above; test desktop/mobile, English/Khmer, light/dark, keyboard navigation and browser console.

For pixel fidelity, transfer only permitted owned assets from the original project: `public/assets/logo_small.png`, `public/assets/logo_square.png`, `public/assets/bizlite-icon-900x900.png` (if present), and `public/loading.gif`. Do not copy third-party packaged assets; install their dependencies instead.
```
